newNormalizationEvidence.finding: At least the inspected matched tariff examples are consistent with the public-map feed exposing VAT-inclusive/consumer-facing rounded prices while the external feed preserves net component prices plus vat=21.
newNormalizationEvidence.caveat: This is strong representation/normalization evidence, not yet proof that every one of the 32 matched connector tariffs is semantically identical. Component pairing, type, step size, dates and restrictions must still be compared after VAT normalization.

officialExternalParity.statusInterpretation: The public reduced slice carries an OCPI-style availability status, whereas the persisted bulk external /evses/operational_status stream exposes a boolean operational_status and different retained keys. Zero direct identifier/status matches therefore does not establish disagreement; identifier and semantic mapping are still required.
officialExternalParity.nextComparison: Implement a VAT-aware component comparator for all 32 connector-ID overlaps: unwrap the public tariff wrapper, pair component type/step/restrictions, compare public observed price to round(external price * (1 + vat/100), consumer precision), and separately compare lifecycle/date restrictions. Resolve EVSE availability against an appropriate external identifier/status representation rather than directly against the bulk boolean feed.

validationDecision.nextSafeStep: Run the VAT-aware semantic comparator over the bounded persisted/sample overlap. Keep the official external collector canonical until tariff equivalence and status mapping are demonstrated systematically.
doNot: run a 582-page national public sweep before semantic parity validation
